issues: No ТР ТС / раздел section headings present anywhere in the table, so tr_section is null on all rows. Row 21's beta-particle-flux unit cell is printed with unusual superscripts '(0,1...100) сек.-4см -2' (likely meant as сек^-1·см^-2 but transcribed exactly as printed). Row 22's magnetic-field-strength ranges mix units within one range (e.g. '80 мА/м- 8 А/м'), so unit is left null and both bounds carry their own unit inline. Temperature ranges ('от минус 40°С до плюс 85°С') are stored as text bounds 'минус 40'/'плюс 85' with unit °С rather than pure numbers, since the sign is verbal in the source. No pages were rotated or illegible.
